readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: The Right Arm's Arsenal
readings.subtitle: Take hold of shield and armour, and rise for my help.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:1] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, strive with <dn>את</dn> those who strive with me; Fight against <dn>את</dn> those who fight against me. [2] Take hold of <dn>את</dn> shield and armour, And rise for my help. [3] And draw out <dn>את</dn> spear and lance, To meet those who pursue me. Say to my life, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> am <dn>Your</dn> deliverance.”</dq>

readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: The Reversal of the Wicked
readings.subtitle: Let his net that he hid catch himself.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:4] Let those be ashamed and blush Who seek my life; Let those be turned back and abashed Who plot evil to me. [5] Let them be as chaff before the wind, With a messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> driving on. [6] Let their way be dark and slippery, With a messenger of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> pursuing them. [7] For without cause they hid their net for me; Without cause they dug a pit for my life. [8] Let ruin come upon him unawares, And let his net that he hid catch himself; Let him fall in it, into ruin.

readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: Exultation in the Deliverer
readings.subtitle: Delivering the poor from one stronger than he.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:9] But let my own being exult in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Let it rejoice in <dn>His</dn> deliverance. [10] Let all my bones say, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who is like <dn>You</dn>, Delivering <dn>את</dn> the poor from one stronger than he, And <dn>את</dn> the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: Unjust Accusations and Ra
readings.subtitle: They reward me evil for good, bereaving my life.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:11] Ruthless witnesses rise up; They ask me that which <dn>I</dn> knew not. [12] They reward me evil for good, bereaving my life. [13] But <dn>I</dn>, when they were sick, <dn>I</dn> put on sackcloth; <dn>I</dn> humbled my being with fastings; And my prayer would return to my own bosom. [14] <dn>I</dn> walked about as though he were my friend or brother; <dn>I</dn> bowed down mourning, as one mourning for a mother.

readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: Gratitude in the Great Assembly
readings.subtitle: Rescue my being from their destructions.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:15] But they rejoiced at my stumbling And gathered together; The smiters gathered against me, And <dn>I</dn> did not know it; They tore in pieces without ceasing, [16] With unclean ones, mockers at feasts, Gnashing at me with their teeth. [17] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, how long would <dn>You</dn> look on? Rescue my being from their destructions, <dn>My</dn> only life from the lions. [18] <dn>I</dn> give <dn>You</dn> thanks in the great assembly; <dn>I</dn> praise <dn>את</dn> <dn>You</dn> among a mighty people.

readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: The Deceitful Plots Exposed
readings.subtitle: They devise words of deceit against the peaceable ones.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:19] Let not my lying enemies rejoice over me; Or those who hate me without cause wink their eyes. [20] For they do not speak peace, But they devise words of deceit Against the peaceable ones of the land. [21] And they open their mouth wide against me, They said, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it.” [22] This <dn>You</dn> have seen, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Do not be silent. O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, do not be far from me.

readings.section: The Protective Hedge and The Right Arm
readings.title: Awakening to Absolute Justice
readings.subtitle: Rule me rightly according to Your righteousness.
readings.text: [Psalm 35:23] Stir up <dn>Yourself</dn> and awake to my right-ruling – To my cause, my <dn>Elohim</dn> and my Master. [24] Rule <dn>את</dn> me rightly, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>, According to <dn>Your</dn> righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me. [25] Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, our desire!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.” [26] Let those who are rejoicing at my evil Be ashamed and abashed altogether; Let those who are exalting themselves over me Be clad in shame and humiliation. [27] Let those who delight in my righteous cause Shout for joy and be glad, And let them always say, “Let <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be made great, Who is desiring the peace of <dn>His</dn> servant.” [28] And my tongue shall speak of <dn>Your</dn> righteousness, <dn>Your</dn> praise, All day long.

readings.title: The Oracle of Transgression
readings.subtitle: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit.
readings.text: [Psalm 36:1] Transgression speaks to the wrong within his heart; Fear of <dn>את</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> is not before his eyes. [2] For he flatters himself in his own eyes, To find his crookedness to be hated. [3] The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit; He has ceased to be wise, to do good. [4] He plots wickedness on his bed; He sets himself in a way that is not good; He does not despise <dn>את</dn> evil.

readings.title: The Substantial Weight of Loving-Commitment
readings.subtitle: In Your light we see light.
readings.text: [Psalm 36:5] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is in the heavens, And <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness reaches to the clouds. [6] <dn>Your</dn> righteousness is like the mighty mountains; <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings are a great deep; O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> save <dn>את</dn> man and beast. [7] How precious is <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, O <dn>Elohim</dn>! And the sons of men take refuge in the shadow of <dn>Your</dn> wings. [8] They are filled from the fatness of <dn>Your</dn> house, And <dn>You</dn> give them drink from the river of <dn>Your</dn> pleasures. [9] For with <dn>You</dn> is the fountain of life; In <dn>Your</dn> light we see light.

readings.title: The Overthrow of Wickedness
readings.subtitle: Draw out Your loving-commitment to those who know You.
readings.text: [Psalm 36:10] Draw out <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment to those who know <dn>You</dn>, And <dn>Your</dn> righteousness to the upright in heart. [11] Let not the foot of pride come against me, And the hand of the wrong drive me away. [12] There the workers of wickedness have fallen; They have been overthrown And have been unable to rise.

readings.title: Relinquishing Control to the Creator
readings.subtitle: Commit your way to YeHoVaH, and trust in Him.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:1] Aleph Do not fret because of evil-doers, Do not be envious of the workers of unrighteousness. [2] For they soon wither like grass, And fade like green plants. [3] Bět Trust in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and do <dn>את</dn> good; Dwell in the earth, and feed on steadfastness. [4] And delight yourself in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And let <dn>Him</dn> give you <dn>את</dn> the desires of your heart. [5] Gimel Commit <dn>את</dn> your way to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And trust in <dn>Him</dn>, and <dn>He</dn> does it. [6] And <dn>He</dn> shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, And your right-ruling as midday.

readings.title: The Authorized Inheritance of the Waiting Ones
readings.subtitle: Rest in YeHoVaH, and wait patiently for Him.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:7] Dalet Rest in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and wait patiently for <dn>Him</dn>; Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way, Because of the man doing wicked devices. [8] Hě Abstain from displeasure, and forsake wrath; Do not fret, also to do evil. [9] For evil-doers are cut off; But those who wait on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, They shall inherit <dn>את</dn> the earth.

readings.title: The Temporal Span of the Wrong
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH laughs at him, for He sees that his day is coming.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:10] Waw Yet a little while and the wrong is no more; And you shall look on his place, But it is not. [11] But the meek ones shall inherit <dn>את</dn> the earth, And delight themselves in plenty of peace. [12] Zayin The wrong plots against the righteous, And gnashes his teeth at him. [13] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> laughs at him, For <dn>He</dn> sees that his day is coming. [14] Ḥet The wrong have drawn the sword And have bent their bow, To cause the poor and needy to fall, To slay those who walk straightly. [15] Their sword does enter into their own heart, And their bows are broken.

readings.title: The Sustained Abundance of the Upright
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH knows the days of the perfect.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:16] Tet Better is the little of the righteous one, Than the riches of many wrongdoers. [17] For the arms of the wrongdoers are broken, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sustains the righteous. [18] Yod <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> knows the days of the perfect, And their inheritance is forever. [19] They are not ashamed in a time of evil, And in the days of scarcity of food they are satisfied. [20] Kaph But the wrongdoers shall perish; And the enemies of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Like the splendour of the meadows they vanish, Like smoke they vanish away.

readings.title: The Ordered Steps of Functional Trust
readings.subtitle: The steps of a man are ordered by YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:21] Lamed The wrongdoer is borrowing and does not repay, But the righteous one shows favour and gives. [22] For <dn>His</dn> blessed ones inherit <dn>את</dn> the earth, But those cursed by <dn>Him</dn> are cut off. [23] Mem The steps of a man are ordered by <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>He</dn> delights in his way. [24] Though he falls, he is not cast down, For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is supporting his hand.

readings.title: The Guarded Seed of Right-Ruling
readings.subtitle: The righteous shall inherit the earth.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:25] Nun <dn>I</dn> have been young, and now <dn>I</dn> am old; Yet <dn>I</dn> have not seen the righteous forsaken, Or his seed begging bread. [26] All day long he is showing favour and lending; And his seed is for a blessing. [27] Sameḵ Turn away from evil, and do <dn>את</dn> good; And dwell forever. [28] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> loves right-ruling, And does not forsake <dn>His</dn> lovingly-committed ones; They shall be guarded forever, But the seed of the wrongdoers is cut off. [29] The righteous shall inherit <dn>את</dn> the earth, And dwell in it forever.

readings.title: The Internalized Torah
readings.subtitle: The Torah of his Elohim is in his heart.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:30] Pě The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, And his tongue talks of right-ruling. [31] The <dn>את</dn> Torah of his <dn>Elohim</dn> is in his heart; <dn>His</dn> steps do not slide. [32] Tsadi The wrong one is watching for the righteous, And is seeking to slay him. [33] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does not leave him in his hand, Or let him be declared wrong when he is judged. [34] Qoph Wait on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> way, And <dn>He</dn> shall exalt you to inherit <dn>את</dn> the earth – When the wrongdoers are cut off, you shall see it.

readings.title: The Ultimate Restoration of Peace
readings.subtitle: The deliverance of the righteous is from YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 37:35] Rěsh <dn>I</dn> have seen the wrongdoer in great power, And spreading himself like a native green tree. [36] Yet he passed away, and see, he was not; And <dn>I</dn> sought him, but he was not found. [37] Shin Watch the perfect, and observe the straight; For the latter end of each is peace. [38] But the transgressors shall be destroyed together; The latter end of the wrong shall be cut off. [39] Tav But the deliverance of the righteous is from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Their strength in time of distress. [40] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does help them and deliver them; <dn>He</dn> delivers them from the wrongdoers and saves them, Because they took refuge in <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: Under the Weight of Crookedness
readings.subtitle: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your rage.
readings.text: [Psalm 38:1] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, do not rebuke <dn>את</dn> me in <dn>Your</dn> wrath, Nor chastise <dn>את</dn> me in <dn>Your</dn> hot displeasure! [2] For <dn>Your</dn> arrows have pierced me, And <dn>Your</dn> hand comes down on me. [3] There is no soundness in my flesh because of <dn>Your</dn> rage, Nor peace in my bones because of my sin. [4] For my crookednesses have passed over my head; Like a heavy burden, too heavy for me. [5] <dn>My</dn> wounds have become stinky, festering Because of my folly. [6] <dn>I</dn> have been bent down; <dn>I</dn> have been bowed down very much; All day long <dn>I</dn> have gone mourning. [7] For my loins have become filled with burning, And there is no soundness in my flesh. [8] <dn>I</dn> have become weak and greatly crushed; <dn>I</dn> howled from the groaning of my heart.

readings.title: The Exposed Heart
readings.subtitle: All my desire is before You.
readings.text: [Psalm 38:9] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all my desire is before <dn>You</dn>; And my sighing has not been hid from <dn>You</dn>. [10] <dn>My</dn> heart is throbbing, my strength has forsaken me; And the light of my eyes also is not with me. [11] <dn>My</dn> loved ones and my friends stand back from my plague, And my neighbours stand far away.

readings.subsection: Hope in the Midst of Affliction
readings.title: The Deafened Ear to Deceit
readings.subtitle: On You, O YeHoVaH, I have waited.
readings.text: [Psalm 38:12] And those seeking my life lay a snare; And those seeking my evil have spoken of destruction, And utter deceit all day long. [13] But <dn>I</dn>, as one deaf, do not hear; And as a dumb one who does not open his mouth. [14] <dn>I</dn> am like a man who does not hear, And who has no rebukes in his mouth. [15] For on <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have waited; <dn>You</dn> do answer, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [16] For <dn>I</dn> said, “Otherwise they would rejoice over me, When my foot slips they would exalt themselves over me.”

readings.subsection: Hope in the Midst of Affliction
readings.title: The Plea for Imminent Help
readings.subtitle: Hasten to help me, O YeHoVaH, my deliverance!
readings.text: [Psalm 38:17] For <dn>I</dn> am ready to fall, And my pain is always with me. [18] For <dn>I</dn> confess <dn>את</dn> my crookedness; <dn>I</dn> am sorry over my sin. [19] But my enemies are alive; They have become strong; And those hating me falsely are many. [20] And those who repay evil for good, They oppose me, because <dn>I</dn> follow <dn>את</dn> what is good. [21] Do not forsake <dn>את</dn> me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; O my <dn>Elohim</dn>, be not far from me! [22] Hasten to help me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my deliverance!
